name: One-day beef
summary: Beef thigh and loin seasoned and dried for a single day, then grilled over charcoal and pounded soft. It is eaten with herbs, cucumber, and muối kiến vàng, the yellow-ant salt.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang is the account, both as a plate and as a gift.
howToEat: The meat is seasoned with sugar, salt, seasoning powder, and ớt hiểm before drying. Grill it, pound it soft, and eat it with herbs, cucumber, and the ant salt.
where: It is also a gift to carry home, alongside frozen tuna, dried squid, bánh tráng, and mắm cá cơm.
seoTitle: Bo mot nang in Phu Yen — dried one day, then grilled
seoDescription: Beef dried for one day, grilled over charcoal, pounded soft, and eaten with herbs and yellow-ant salt.
